categories.main_business_segments: Shanxi Coking Coal Energy Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in coal mining, coal washing and processing, coal sales, power generation and supply, coking, chemical products, and building materials. The company owns 17 coal mines with rich coal reserves and produces various coal types including coking coal, fat coal, lean coal, and gas coal. It also engages in power generation, coke production, chemical products, and building materials manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced mining and coal processing technologies, including intelligent and digital mining techniques, 5G-enabled smart mining, and innovative gas extraction and sealing technologies. It focuses on green and low-carbon production methods, safety management systems, and lean production management. R&D projects include coal seam mining methods, gas extraction technologies, and coal quality evaluation systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are large steel, coking, and power generation enterprises mainly located in Northeast, North China, South China, and East China regions. Key customers include major steel groups such as Shougang Group, State Grid Shanxi Electric Power Company, and other large industrial clients. The company serves the industrial sector with coal and related energy products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Shanxi Province, China, with mining bases in Jinzhong, Linfen, Lvliang, and Yuncheng regions. Its sales cover major Chinese regions including Northeast, North China, South China, and East China. It also holds exploration rights in Lvliang City, Shanxi Province, for coal and associated minerals.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanxi Coking Coal Energy Group operates primarily upstream in the coal mining and processing sector, extending into midstream activities such as coal washing, coking, and chemical production, and downstream power generation and building materials manufacturing. It integrates resource extraction with processing and energy supply, positioning itself as a comprehensive energy and coal products supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes high-quality development, technological innovation, and green low-carbon transformation. Strategic R&D focuses on intelligent mining, gas extraction and safety technologies, coal quality evaluation, and digital transformation. It aims to enhance core competitiveness, promote flexible production, and accelerate the transition to a modern integrated energy service provider.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of coal products, electricity and heat supply, coke and chemical products sales, and building materials. The company also earns income from entrusted management fees and government subsidies. Sales are conducted via direct sales contracts with industrial customers and through integrated supply chain services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the domestic coking coal industry with significant resource reserves and production capacity. It holds a strong market position in high-quality coking coal supply in China, competing with other major coal mining and energy companies. It is recognized as a key stabilizer in the coking coal market and a leader in the Shanxi coal industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 45.29 billion, a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.11 billion, and total assets of about RMB 110 billion. Despite a revenue decline compared to previous years, the company maintains a stable growth trajectory with ongoing investments in resource acquisition and technology. It has a substantial workforce of over 37,000 employees and continues to expand its coal reserves and production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanxi Coking Coal Energy Group offers high-quality, low-ash, low-sulfur coking coal with excellent coking properties, critical for steel production. Its resource advantages, stable geological conditions, and advanced mining technologies ensure reliable supply and product quality. The company emphasizes safety, environmental responsibility, and integrated energy solutions, differentiating itself through technological innovation, flexible production, and strong customer partnerships.
